sources.name: IndianaMap / Indiana DNR Lake Bathymetry Contours
sources.attribution: Indiana Department of Natural Resources, Division of Fish and Wildlife
sources.notes: Polyline bathymetric contours; shoreline = elevation 0; contour values are feet below surface. Surveyed with Biosonics DTX echosounder. Contour intervals vary by lake (commonly 5 or 10 ft). Updated ~2019 in FeatureServer; some newer PDF surveys not yet in vector layer.

notes_sylvan: Sylvan Lake (Noble) contours added 2026-09-23 from DNR West+East basin PDFs via raster digitization; not present in IndianaMap FeatureServer vector layer.

sources.name: Indiana DNR Fish & Wildlife — Fishing Access Sites
sources.notes: Official public access sites; boat_ramp=Yes / Boat Ramp / Carry Down / Canoe Ramp.

sources.name: IndianaMap Recreational Facility Locations
sources.access: private (areatype Private or Commercial with rampnu>0)
sources.notes: State inventory of private/commercial facilities that report boat ramps. Not a guarantee of public entry.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (leisure=slipway, marina, amenity=boat_rental)
sources.access: from OSM access=* tag (private/customers/members → private; yes/public → public; else unknown)
sources.notes: Deduped against DNR/rec within ~120 m. Untagged slipways labeled unknown. Private club launches not in OSM/state inventories are intentionally omitted.

caveats: Private launch coverage is limited to sites published in the state recreational facilities inventory or OSM with access=private/customers/members.
Do not treat private/commercial markers as guaranteed guest access — confirm with the operator.
No gated club directories were scraped; absence of a private ramp does not mean none exist.
launches.rebuild: python3 scripts/rebuild_launches.py  # requires shapely; copies to public/data/
